fact: The Ministry of Digital Economy says the DRC is preparing a project to build a Technopark and a sovereign data centre in the extension zone of Kinshasa, and the minister's Skolkovo visit is to inform the Technopark's design.

Silikin Village in Kinshasa, backed by the Texaf Group, says it has supported over 300 project leaders and entrepreneurs in five years and is launching the 'Grow & Help Grow' acceleration programme, whose first cohort of five tech entrepreneurs will run nine months.
Bankable reports Silikin Village in Kinshasa was inaugurated on 10 October 2024 and offers training and incubation programmes for startups.
